carried_store.behavioral_identity: Verbatim append-only episodes; context is a pure function and has no lineage or current-value state.

benchmark_audit.reason: The class mixes replacement, accumulation, and multi-session reasoning; answer_session_ids names evidence sessions but does not identify supersedes edges.

name_to_behavior.supersession: an explicit old-to-new content-hash edge, not text inference
name_to_behavior.accessibility: a binary natural-retrieval gate independent of cosine
name_to_behavior.silent: excluded from natural retrieval while content and edges remain
name_to_behavior.lineage: deliberate oldest-to-newest traversal that bypasses accessibility
